QuestInfo.name: Eurenth's Advice
QuestInfo.0: You've finally done enough of #b#p3001002##k's small errands. Now it's time to ask his advice!
QuestInfo.1: Go to #b#m401020300##k and use the #bD-03#k transmitter.
QuestInfo.2: You attempted to communicate with the merchant crew when a masked man appeared out of nowhere.

0.0: Mmm, I guess you have talent for doing errands, at least. I can't give you a hard time like that Nova guardian though... Meh... All right then, what did you need?\r\n#L0##bI want to know how to infiltrate the enemy lines.#l\n#k
0.1: Mmm... I see. You know, I don't know how either! Bahahaha!\r\n#L0##b(Rage...RISING.)#l\n#k
0.2: But I know who does! They're a cool bunch called 'Grandis Shadow.' You can work with them, just don't get too close or you'll get burned.\r\nOf course, they won't do anything for free.\r\n

yes.0: Take this. It's called a #bD-03 Transmitter#k. If you keep going north, you'll run into an empty lot where monsters don't live. I think it was called... #r#m401020300##k? Anyways, it's a good place for communication.
yes.1: The signal isn't the most reliable. If you don't connect right away, try, try again.

no.0: Do whatever you want. It's no skin off my snout!
